crossrefs.text: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Humble yourselves, therefore, under Godʼs mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
As a fellow elder, a witness of Christʼs sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.

See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”
Isnʼt it to share your bread with the hungry, to bring the poor and homeless into your home, to clothe the naked when you see him, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?
They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip; avoid the one who babbles with his lips.
Honor the widows who are truly widows.
The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,
Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.

This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.
In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.

Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.
Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Who tends a flock and does not drink of its milk?
Isnʼt He actually speaking on our behalf? Indeed, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they should also expect to share in the harvest.
But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.
In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
